source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Single-story building (only 1F plan supplied); ceiling height 4.5m taken from facade total height dimension.
North=top, South=bottom, West=left, East=right of 1f_view.png, confirmed by matching elevation dimension chains to plan wall dimension chains.
Room columns (west/east) and row boundaries derived from coarse dimension chains (4060/2940/4940/8060 west, 4060/1940/5940/3120/4940 east) matched against visible partition lines.
Central corridor width taken as gap between visible parallel wall lines (~1.64m), connecting all rooms via doors seen as arcs in plan.

Interior door widths/positions are approximate (visible arcs used for host wall and general position, but not measured precisely); D5b (corridor-west_storage2) is inferred since only one clear arc was seen serving the double storage room area.

Window sill/head heights approximated from elevation dimension groups (typically sill 1.0m, head 3.4m on N/W/E walls; sill 1.0m head 2.8m on S windows); exact figures not individually re-verified per opening.
Door heights set to 2.4m (floor to head) as a standard assumption; some elevation dimension chains showed unusual bottom offsets (e.g. 200mm) not modeled.
Wall thickness observed as 240mm in several plan annotations but not implemented as explicit wall_references/offsets in this pass.

unresolved: Exact partition wall between the two west storage rooms and its door not fully confirmed pixel-by-pixel.
East wall exterior door (D11) position approximate; original arc position only roughly read from a narrow crop.
Fine dimension chains on facades (window positions) matched to rows via approximate pixel/row correspondence; not converted through calibrated map_pixels/dimension-chain tools.
No wall_references/wall_dimensions records saved; 240mm thickness annotations exist in source but are not yet attached to boundary IDs.
Furniture-implied room use (office/meeting/lobby) is a label guess, not verified against any legend.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

current_source_projections.basis: x anchors from north/south dimension chain tick pixels (0mm at left wall, 10000mm at right wall); y anchors from west facade dimension chain tick pixels (0mm world y at south/bottom wall pixel893, 20000mm world y at north/top wall pixel153), matching plan orientation top=North.

calibration_warnings.guidance: x=36.6 px/m and y=37 px/m disagree by 1.086957%, over the 0.300000% limit — at least one endpoint pair or transcribed dimension is likely wrong. Do not silently trust the blended px_per_m below: re-crop and re-measure both axes' anchors at their dimension-chain extension-line intersections, then recalibrate. If you must proceed now, prefer the single-axis scale (axis_px_per_m) for geometry measured along that axis over the blended value, and record this disagreement instead of treating the reading as clean.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
